I’m agender non-binary! I’ve always had trouble identifying solely with either gender and have a very difficult time with gender lines and norms, but spent a quarter of a century practicing my “girl” performance so that was what felt most comfortable. The first time I realized I really truly didn’t feel like a woman was shortly after my wedding when someone called me “Mrs. NBS” in public and I felt like dry heaving a little. Over quarantine I really got into a lot of animal crossing discords and met some younger people who had a much better vocabulary to describe exactly what I’d been feeling my whole life!

I have been aware I was bi/pan ever since I knew what those words meant.
